comparison_type: Retrospective static artifact comparison; not a randomized or time-efficiency experiment.
metric_definition: For the three E_PUR_001-vs-C0 metric deltas (SSIM, PSNR, MAE), count whether each has machine-readable source locator, explicit operation and tolerance, and a successful recomputation. Generic filename references do not meet this narrow criterion.
assessment: AI-assisted inspection of actual artifacts; the original rounded deltas are not counted as errors. This metric measures added audit structure, not scientific quality or time saved.
